Definition: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Hezekiah breaks in pieces the brasen serpent Moses had made, because Israel has begun to burn incense to it, and he calls it Nehushtan — a piece of brass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hezekiah was right to break it: the serpent that once healed had become an idol, and the thing God used to save must never become the thing men worship.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
